name: Nikaidou Benimaru
source:
Country: Japan.
The son of a millionare, Benimaru is a model/pro fighter brimming with confidence. A flirt who respects women, but can come off as flighty. Despite this, he has a heart of gold. While flamboyant, when it comes to fighting he's here to win. His hair stays up using his ability to manipulate electricity.
